item.title: Board of Peace will ask the UN Security Council to press Hamas to disarm
item.description: The body overseeing the U.S.-brokered ceasefire in Gaza plans to ask the United Nations Security Council to press Hamas to disarm

item.title: Lettuce introduce you to the live frog found in this grocery store salad bag
item.description: An Australian farmer has found a live frog in a bag of lettuce

item.title: Kyiv holds a funeral for 2 young sisters killed by a Russian missile strike
item.description: The St. Michael’s Golden-Domed Monastery in Kyiv has become a place of mourning for many

item.title: Opposition leaders in the Bahamas demand probe after US ties politician to drug trafficking case
item.description: Opposition leaders in the Bahamas are demanding an investigation after a U.S. federal agent alleged that a suspected drug trafficker who survived a recent plane crash near Florida was rescued and found with roughly $30,000

item.title: Russia holds massive drills of its nuclear forces as Ukraine steps up its drone attacks
item.description: The Russian military has begun drills of its nuclear forces that will feature practice launches of nuclear-capable ballistic and cruise missiles

item.title: This hard-line Iranian general is a major player in talks with US over war
item.description: A hard-line Iranian general linked to notorious attacks at home and abroad is believed to have seized a place near the center of power as negotiations with the United States hang in the balance

item.title: Montenegro at 20: After breaking with Serbia and joining NATO, EU is the next frontier
item.description: Montenegro marks 20 years of independence from a union with Serbia this week, celebrating a two-decade transformation that has already brought the Balkan country into NATO

item.title: Japan records bigger exports and imports in April, despite oil supply concerns
item.description: Japan has reported its exports soared nearly 15% in April from a year earlier as its trade remained robust despite worries over supplies of oil and gas due to the war in Iran

item.title: In Iran's capital, weapons demonstrations send a signal at home and abroad as threat of war remains
item.description: Weapons are now regularly brandished in Tehran in an increasing show of defiance

item.title: US test fires mobile rocket system near Mount Fuji in rapid 'shoot and scoot' drill
item.description: U.S. Marines test fired a dozen rockets from a HIMARS launcher near Mount Fuji in Japan, highlighting a weapon system that is becoming increasingly important to the U.S. military
